english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an act or treatment that humiliates someone or affronts their dignity.
This is the all-purpose choice for a deliberately rude remark or act aimed at humiliating someone.
Use this when the scorn takes the form of an insulting or degrading slight.
Use this only when the slight amounts to a clear insult or humiliation, which is stronger than an ordinary snub.

examples.english: Being scolded in front of so many people was a real indignity.
examples.traditional: 佢當住咁多人鬧我，真係一種侮辱。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 naau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou5 juk6

examples.english: Calling me useless in front of everyone is a real insult.
examples.traditional: 你當住咁多人話我冇用，真係一種侮辱。
examples.jyutping: nei5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 waa6 ngo5 mou5 jung6 zan1 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou5 juk6

examples.english: Calling someone useless in public is pure scorn.
examples.traditional: 當眾話人廢柴，根本就係一種侮辱。
examples.jyutping: dong1 zung3 waa6 jan4 fai3 caai4 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou5 juk6

examples.english: Calling me useless in front of everyone was a humiliating slight.
examples.traditional: 佢當眾話我冇用，根本係侮辱。
